blocks.text: Setup day (Book 00 Ch. 4 + Book 01 Ch. 1), about 45 min. Gallery stacks 01 Procreate, 02 Gesture, 03 Form, 04 Proportion. Make the error-log note (date · drill · predicted · actual · rule). Build a drill template and a painting template. Tune the pressure curve in small steps. Eyedropper on touch-and-hold. QuickMenu: Flip Horizontal, New Layer, Clear Layer, Merge Down, Curves, Liquify. End with 15 min of loose sketching to test it all.

guideText:
How this plan works
Each week gets one page. Every day has a fixed shape, so you never decide what to do, you just do the row. Everything here comes from the programme chapters of the books. Where I had to choose (mostly where two books claim the same slot), it's flagged below.
Every session, in this order
Before
Read the last three rules in your error log (Book 00).
5 min
Warm-up, the exact one written in the row. It changes as you finish books (see the rotation on the next page).
20 min
Focus, the drill in the row. Write the date and drill name on the canvas.
5 min
Check: predict where you went wrong BEFORE comparing, compare honestly, write ONE rule.
After
Save in the book's stack as YYYY-MM-DD · drill. Never delete a drill, especially the bad ones. The rules that keep it working
• Weeks are the earliest you can move on, not deadlines. Each book ends with its move-on test on the last Saturday. Pass most checks and you move on. Fail, and you repeat the book's last 1-2 weeks and shift every later date by that much. The books' typical times are longer than their programmes (Book 03: 4-6 weeks, Books 05-06: 5-8 weeks), so slipping is normal, not failure.
• Ten minutes counts. On a bad day: five gestures + one quick check. Only zero breaks the streak (Book 00).
• Sunday is rest. If you feel dread instead of curiosity, take an extra day off or just paint for fun.
• Every Saturday: watch one time-lapse of the week (Actions → Video → Time-lapse Replay) and look for where you started small or skipped steps.
• Benchmarks are on each book's first Saturday (Book 04: Day 1 Monday). Redraw the SAME photo on the last Saturday. Save the photos in albums so you can find them.
• Look after your hand: long lines from the shoulder, a break every 25-30 min on long Saturdays. Pain or tingling that doesn't go away means rest, and see a doctor if it persists.
• If you're already further along than Book 01, skip to that book's first week and count the weeks forward from your Monday.
Two choices I made for you
1. The painting books (09-12) run as a Saturday Block B from February. Book 00 says to do 09, 10 and 11 at weekends alongside the structure books, but every structure book also has its own Saturday exercise. So from Book 05 on, Saturday is Block A (structure) → 10-min break → Block B (30 min of painting). Each painting book is compressed to 3-6 Saturdays. If Saturdays get too long, drop Block B and do Books 09-12 as normal four-week weekday books after Book 08 instead. 2. Book 04 gets a fifth week for its Days 29-30 review and a proper run of its six-check move-on test, since proportion is the skill you named as hardest.
